name: Seeed XIAO ePaper 7.5" (black/white/red)
description: Seeed XIAO ESP32-S3 driving a 7.5 inch black/white/red tri-colour ePaper panel (800x480). Speaks Tesserae's v1 REST device API and paints a raw 2-bpp packed buffer (96000 bytes) produced by the esp32_bin renderer against the bwr_3 gamut. Same board as xiao_epaper_75; pick this kind when a BWR panel is fitted and the unit runs the BWR firmware build.
notes_md: Awaiting confirmed test on real hardware (firmware in progress). Wire format is exactly 96000 bytes (800*480/4), row-major from top-left, 4 pixels per byte MSB first (bits 7-6 = leftmost pixel); 2-bit value 0b00 = black, 0b01 = white, 0b10 = red, 0b11 reserved and never emitted by the server (firmware renders a stray 0b11 as white). No pre-rotation or mirroring; the firmware handles any panel-side transform. Same physical board as `xiao_epaper_75`; the server migrates a registered unit between the mono and BWR kinds automatically when its firmware re-registers or re-discovers declaring the other kind (same-protocol kind heal), keeping the device row, token, and history.
